_game: MEG template: an fMRI curriculum plus a 'triggers' section
_note: sync.mode 'send' emits scanner_start on the marker line after the experimenter's SPACE (MEG acquisitions started from the trigger input); use 'wait' for an fMRI trigger box. markers.backend null | lsl | serial | parallel (pip install pylsl / pyserial / pyparallel); a backend that cannot be opened stops the run with the reason. Codes are non-overlapping bit fields (frames 1-7, lifecycle bits 8/16/32/64); see README 'Triggers'.
